metaTitle: Custom 1 Inch Wide Products | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 1 inch wide products for branding. Perfect for giveaways and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need promotional items that fit narrow spaces like pen loops or badge holders, 1 inch wide products offer a compact canvas for your logo. From custom lanyards to silicone wristbands, this size works well for trade show giveaways and employee incentives. Decorate with screen printing or debossing for a clean, professional look that stands out in a crowd.
